title: An educational activity tailored for undergraduate students on AI-driven nanobody design for targeted antiviral therapeutics.
authors: Idris, Adi; Idres, Yusuf M; Bhattacharjee, Kamanasish; Gao, Wenqing
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍面向本科生的AI驱动纳米抗体设计教学活动，使用生成式AI平台GeoFlow-V3设计抗流感病毒纳米抗体，虽为教学应用且方法创新有限，但核心涉及蛋白质结构设计与生成式AI，与课题相关。
abstract: Protein-based biologics are converging at an unprecedented pace as generative artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes early-stage drug discovery. Nanobodies, single-domain antibody fragments derived from camelid heavy chain-only immunoglobulins, are an emerging class of antiviral biologics prized for their small size, stability, and access to cryptic viral epitopes. Traditional nanobody discovery relies on animal immunization and phage display screening, a process that can take 6 to 12 months and is entirely inaccessible within a standard undergraduate laboratory session. Here, we describe a succinct, in silico-based laboratory activity that uses a generative AI protein design server, GeoFlow-V3 (https://prot.design/), to allow undergraduate students to design a novel antiviral nanobody against the influenza A virus (IAV) hemagglutinin (HA) protein. This activity builds on our group's prior use of generative AI for undergraduate siRNA design teaching and extends the same pedagogical model to structural protein engineering. To our knowledge, this is the first use of a generative AI protein design platform for teaching nanobody design at the undergraduate level.
abstract_zh: 基于蛋白质的生物制剂正以前所未有的速度汇聚，因为生成式人工智能（AI）正在重塑早期药物发现。纳米抗体（nanobodies）是源自骆驼科重链-only免疫球蛋白的单域抗体片段，是一类新兴的抗病毒生物制剂，因其体积小、稳定性高以及能够接触隐蔽病毒表位而备受青睐。传统的纳米抗体发现依赖于动物免疫和噬菌体展示筛选，这一过程可能需要6至12个月，并且在标准本科实验室课程中完全不可行。在此，我们描述了一种简洁的、基于计算机模拟的实验室活动，利用生成式AI蛋白质设计服务器GeoFlow-V3（https://prot.design/），使本科生能够设计针对甲型流感病毒（IAV）血凝素（HA）蛋白的新型抗病毒纳米抗体。该活动建立在我们团队先前将生成式AI用于本科siRNA设计教学的基础上，并将相同的教学模式扩展到结构蛋白质工程领域。据我们所知，这是首次在本科层面使用生成式AI蛋白质设计平台进行纳米抗体设计教学。
